title: Bias and Volatility: A Statistical Framework for Evaluating Large Language Model's Stereotypes and the Associated Generation Inconsistency

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating the probability distribution of gender-associated tokens (e.g., pronouns, gendered nouns) conditioned on occupation words across a diverse set of data-mined sentence templates to measure systematic bias (mean) and generative volatility (variance).

Estimating the probability distribution of race-associated tokens (e.g., white, black, asian) conditioned on occupation words across a diverse set of data-mined sentence templates to measure systematic bias and generative volatility.

Estimating the probability distribution of religion-associated tokens (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Hindu) conditioned on occupation words across varied sentence templates to compute aggregated discrimination risk.

Estimating the probability distribution of disability-associated tokens (e.g., deaf, blind, autistic) conditioned on occupation words across varied sentence templates to compute aggregated discrimination risk.
